selections.rationale: Trace a concrete context-preservation suspicion at forwarded ReadIndex completion. The leader queues each original context but constructs every remote response using the final heartbeat context. The local ReadyToRead branch instead uses each saved context. Consumer batches require exact context equality. Prefix uses Launch, durable-update simulation and real tick-driven election; no fabricated vote or commitment. Two lost initial heartbeats followed by reliable delivery preserve ordering of delivered messages. Supplied contexts are distinct nonzero values permitted by Peer.ReadIndex and consistent with the caller shape (random nonzero Low, tick+30 High); this does not execute NodeHost clients or establish a client deadline breach.

Run a fresh direct check of original-context preservation using the successful real protocol prefix. Keep the newer request as an independent same-history control; do not infer client completion from ReadyToRead.
